svg.title: Paired evaluation of recovery costs after poisoned energy-agent decisions
svg.desc: Inputs feed the paired attacked and reference runs. Their detection states feed two parallel branches: constrained recovery-cost evaluation, and rolling recovery-controller comparison. Predicted cost differences and realised outcomes meet at validation. The attribution scalar does not feed any controller. A bottom panel states the optimisation model (objective and constraints) used in steps 1 to 3.
